input.prompt: An ancient Greek terracotta storage amphora about 1.05 m tall, standing upright: a tall ovoid body, widest at the shoulder and tapering smoothly down to a short solid toe knob with a small flat end it stands on; a narrow cylindrical neck with a thick rounded rim; two strong vertical loop handles of round section from the top of the neck down to the shoulder, one on each side. Isolated on a plain, seamless, uniform pure white background. Soft, even, diffuse studio lighting from all around: no harsh highlights, no cast shadow or contact shadow, no floor, no reflections of surroundings.
